entries.title: Phase 12A production grounding hardening authorized
changes: Phase 12 remains the accepted Production V1 baseline; Phase 12A is current and in progress.
Run 003 is retained as accepted black-box evidence with unresolved output-integrity and redirect-to-private findings.

Phase 12A requires a critical frozen BEFORE verified-output sequence, TDD RED evidence, server-owned evidence binding, deterministic synthesis gating, real-stack Run 004, and exact-main revalidation before merge.
Phase 13-16 remain OPTIONAL; no Pretio integration or deployment is authorized by this phase.

entries.title: Correct Phase 12A closure authority before Run 006
changes: Phase 12A remains CURRENT; its closure gate is based on the latest repair candidate passing the current real-stack regression campaign, not on Run 004 specifically.
Run 004 and Run 005 remain preserved as historical failed acceptance evidence; Run 006 is the next attempt on the original frozen Run 003 corpus and does not replace prior evidence.

Closure requires all blocking verification, citation, fail-closed, security, persistence, corpus-preservation, and evidence-preservation gates, pushed final passing evidence, GitHub cross-platform CI, and exact merged-main revalidation.

entries.title: Phase 12A isolated source repair and corrective plan evidence
changes: Resumed implementation from the isolated local worktree without overwriting the owner working tree; server-owned evidence spans and claim verification passed 214 local unit tests at the first checkpoint.
Added RED and GREEN regression proving operator scratch directories cannot pollute generated Project Truth or source digests, then passed 216 unit tests and Python compile.

Preserved the original Phase 12A BEFORE plan, recorded its invalid direct SOURCE-edge topology as PLAN_CHANGE, and froze the corrected source topology at 0a0fe3c560947761036ec2069f46edccb2b91c72 with source-verifiable call edges and documented behavior.
Nineteen sequence sessions passed in the isolated local worktree after the corrective freeze. This is intermediate evidence, not real-stack Run 006 or final Phase 12A acceptance.
Phase 12A remains IN_PROGRESS; PR #29 remains Draft, with no deployment, Pretio integration, or main merge authorized until all blocking Run 006 and GitHub acceptance gates pass.

An additional local Ollama compatibility regression was added with expected RED then GREEN: explicit runtime 0.40.0 is admitted, future unknown 0.41.0 remains rejected, and fixed model/dimension validation is preserved. A real adapter request produced one query and one document vector of 1024 dimensions in the Owner's Ollama 0.40.0 environment. This is an embedding-only smoke, not full-stack acceptance.

Downloaded the official Qdrant Windows v1.19.1 release to isolated project runtime space only after matching GitHub SHA-256 9b6f69bd85f6abed4bc13f943099f55c6ffd55f5dd90388635320d8fbb569eb0; Qdrant and MAX Grounding REST were bound to localhost only. No system-wide installation or public deployment occurred.

Corrected stale Phase 12 E2E negative-reference format and five-tool MCP assumption; the real local Ollama 0.40.0 / Qdrant 1.19.1 / MAX Grounding REST and MCP campaign passed authenticated service, query, security negative path, and 16-query concurrency-4 bounded load smoke. Smoke latency is not a production SLA.

The shared Qdrant E2E collection caused a historical restart ranking mismatch after another campaign indexed a different gold document. Isolated the Phase 11 index/restart fixture collection, added tests for production/test isolation, and reran real index then Qdrant process restart and query successfully with two persisted evidence points.

Local real-stack smoke and restart proof are intermediate PC evidence only; the frozen 27-task Run 006 corpus campaign, redirect-to-private security gate, and other Phase 12A blocking acceptance criteria remain NOT_PROVEN.
